title: Playground
lead: Every panel below drives a real instance through the public API. Change an input and the library answers — nothing here is a recording.

parser.title: Message formats
parser.lead: The core holds no message format of its own: a parser fills the slot. Curly comes with this package; ICU is the alternative, on the core directly.
parser.silent: No reports. A report never raises — the placeholder takes its fallback and the rest of the message resolves.

preprocess.title: Preprocessing
preprocess.lead: Nested translations become the flat keys t() reads. The mode decides how far that goes.
preprocess.note: rawTranslations keeps the input as it arrived; translations is what you see here.

loaders.title: Loaders
loaders.lead: A loader runs when its locale matches and its routes match the current route, once per freshness window. Load the same route twice and watch the second attempt do nothing.
loaders.empty: Pick a locale and a route, then load.

fallback.title: Fallback locale
fallback.lead: A key the active locale does not carry resolves through fallbackLocale instead of rendering empty.
fallback.note: Only the missing keys fall back. What a key missing everywhere renders as is fallbackValue.
